Translation services are available in many forms, from professional translators to online tools. With the rapid development technology, you can definitely find a trusted certified translator nowadays.

However, the process might not be too easy sometimes because there are too many translation services out there in Los Angeles.

Today, we'll share 4 ways to find translation services online to help you smooth the finding process.

1. Search for Local Translators by City.

If you're looking for a local translator in Los Angeles, start with Google Maps. Type in the placeyou'd like to translate into and click "Translate." You'll see a list of results that includes the name of the company, address, phone number, and website.

You can also type in "certificated translation services near me", Google Maps will filter the results that suit your location the best. For example, after you type such keyword, local certified translation companies, like American Education and Translation Services, will show up for you to contact.

2. Look for Professional Translations from Companies with Good Reputations.

It's also possible to find professional translators through websites like atanet.org. As a well-known association, American Translators Association offers you a variety of different certified translation job opportunities, so you should be able to find one that fits your needs.

Historical ATA corporate membership certificate

If you're looking for a reliable translation service, look for one that has been around for at least five years. You want to be sure that the certified translation company has a solid reputation and that it's been providing quality translations for clients for a while.

After you find one company, you can go on Google or Yelp to make sure they have good reviews besides being ATA certified. If the company has over 10 years of experience and all five-star reviews, then it could be the right one.

3. Ask Friends and Family for Recommendations.

You can also ask friends and family members for recommendations. This is a good option because they likely know other certified translation services that might be able to help you.

You might be surprised at what they suggest. For example, some people might recommend Google Translate for translating websites from English to Spanish, Italian, Chinese and more. However, it is always a good choice to find a trusted certified translator. Here is the list of some companies that provide translation services in Los Angeles:

  • MendWord Translation Services
  • California Center for Translation & Interpretation
  • STC Interpreting & Translation
  • L.A. Translation
  • American Education & Translation Services

4. Contact Your Local Translator Directly.

If you're looking for a local business that offers translation services, start by asking people you know. They may be able to recommend a company that's close to home.
